name: Tenjin Tatsuhiko
source:
Hiro's close friend and fellow member of the Syouba High School basketball team. A leading basketball member alongside Hiro. Every time something good happened to him, he shared it with Hiro.

[spoiler]Tatsuhiko is known as one of the two most popular boys in the school alongside Hiro. He fell in love with Moe Miyazawa at first sight.[/spoiler]


(Description from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185680/White_Wings]Steam[/url])
